mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_table_registry ( registry_time TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '目录固定时间键', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务编号', interface_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '采集接口主键', source_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '来源类型英文编码', source_identity STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '设备主键或原始卫星代号', parameter_table STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '参数分表名称', frame_table STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '整帧分表名称', TIME INDEX (registry_time), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_daily_statistics ( stat_date TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '统计日期', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务ID', satellite_code STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '卫星代号，设备数据为空字符串', telemetry_code STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '遥测代号', telemetry_name STRING COMMENT '遥测名称', max_value DOUBLE COMMENT '最大值', min_value DOUBLE COMMENT '最小值', avg_value DOUBLE COMMENT '平均值', variance DOUBLE COMMENT '方差', telemetry_status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '遥测状态类型', created_at TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '统计结果生成时间', TIME INDEX (stat_date), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, satellite_code, telemetry_code, telemetry_status) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')
mapper.select: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_schema = #{databaseName} AND table_name = 'telemetry_daily_statistics' AND constraint_name = 'PRIMARY' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT task_id, CASE WHEN source_type = 'rpc' THEN source_identity ELSE '' END AS satellite_code, telemetry_code, MAX(telemetry_name) AS telemetry_name, COALESCE(state_type, '') AS telemetry_status, MAX(`value`) AS max_value, MIN(`value`) AS min_value, AVG(`value`) AS avg_value, VAR_POP(`value`) AS variance, COUNT(`value`) AS sample_count FROM __greptime_table__ WHERE source_time >= #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND source_time < #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY task_id, CASE WHEN source_type = 'rpc' THEN source_identity ELSE '' END, telemetry_code, COALESCE(state_type, '')
mapper.insert:

(#{statDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.satelliteCode}, #{row.telemetryCode}, #{row.telemetryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.maxValue,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.minValue,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.avgValue,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.variance,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.telemetryStatus}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})

INSERT INTO telemetry_table_registry (registry_time, task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, parameter_table, frame_table) VALUES (#{registryTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{taskId}, #{interfaceId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceIdentity}, #{parameterTable}, #{frameTable})

mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS __greptime_table__ ( source_time TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '源时间', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务编号', interface_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '采集接口主键', source_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '来源类型', source_identity STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '本地设备卫星主键或远程卫星代号', telemetry_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '遥测类型', device_satellite_name STRING COMMENT '设备卫星名称', channel_name STRING COMMENT '通道名称', `raw` BINARY COMMENT '完整采集报文', check_status STRING INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '帧检查状态编码', TIME INDEX (source_time), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS __greptime_table__ ( source_time TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '源时间', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务编号', source_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '来源类型', source_identity STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '本地设备卫星主键或远程卫星代号', telemetry_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '遥测类型', telemetry_code STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '遥测代号', telemetry_name STRING COMMENT '参数名称', value_type STRING COMMENT '遥测值类型编码', `value` DOUBLE COMMENT '遥测数值', value_text STRING COMMENT '遥测值文本原文', `raw` BINARY COMMENT '参数原码', state_name STRING COMMENT '参数状态名称原文', state_type STRING COMMENT '参数状态类型编码', state_index INT COMMENT '参数状态索引', processed_at TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '处理时间', TIME INDEX (source_time), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, telemetry_code) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')
mapper.sql: source_time, task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, device_satellite_name, channel_name, `raw`, check_status

SELECT source_type, source_identity, telemetry_code, source_time, telemetry_type, `value` FROM __greptime_table__
AND `value` IS NOT NULL
